blocks.text:
Transfer to the airport at the scheduled time.

If the schedule allows, you can visit the **Larco Herrera Museum** on the way.

Founded in the early 20th century, the museum occupies an 18th-century mansion built in the colonial style for a viceroy of Peru.

Its collection contains more than **45,000 objects**, including ceramics, textiles, jewellery, gold, mummies and a well-known collection of erotic pottery.

The exhibition introduces the history and daily life of the Inca, Moche, Nazca and Chimú cultures.

**Admission:** $65 per person.

The museum also has a restaurant serving Peruvian cuisine, **Café del Museo**.

After the visit, continue your transfer to the airport.

blocks.text: This is one of the most comprehensive itineraries through Peru. You begin with the capital on the Pacific coast and Lima's main landmarks, then head up into the Andes to explore the Inca legacy. After Machu Picchu, the route continues through Lake Titicaca, Colca and Arequipa. The northern section adds a very different chapter of history: the Chimú civilisation, the vast adobe city of Chan Chan, the Temples of the Sun and the Moon, Huaca Rajada and the Lord of Sipán Museum.
